title: Sign-up forms
description: Grow your audience and expand your business’s reach with forms.

top_articles.title: Getting started with sign-up forms
top_articles.description: Learn how to create and customize sign-up forms in Klaviyo to publish on your website so you can engage shoppers, collect emails and phone numbers, and build long-lasting customer relationships.

top_articles.title: How to manage your sign-up forms
top_articles.description: Learn tips for managing your existing sign-up forms so you can ensure they are aesthetically pleasing and functional for customers interested in engaging with your brand.

top_articles.title: Understanding form blocks and fields
top_articles.description: Learn how to use various content blocks from the form editor (i.e., elements and input fields) in your sign-up form to customize its appearance and the type of information you collect from subscribers.

top_articles.title: Understanding styles for a sign-up form
top_articles.description: Learn how to use Klaviyo’s sign-up form builder to design your form by editing the design settings available in the Styles section. Style settings apply across your sign-up form, including in all of a form’s steps and in its success message.

top_articles.title: Understanding targeting and behavior settings for sign-up forms
top_articles.description: Learn about the Targeting & behavior section of the sign-up form editor, where you can control and change when a form appears on your site, and who sees it. Open the form editor for an existing sign-up form, then select Targeting & behavior to adjust the display and targeting settings covered in this guide.

top_articles.title: Getting started with consent pages
top_articles.description: Learn about the different consent pages related to Klaviyo lists, including the preferences, subscribe, and unsubscribe pages, and how to customize them.

top_articles.title: Understanding SMS consent collection
top_articles.description: Learn about SMS consent, including what counts as SMS consent, how you can collect it, and how resubscribes work. SMS consent refers to whether someone is opted in (i.e., if they have agreed to receive marketing text messages from your brand).
